headline: Review contracts and payments for Essex Street Paving, Roger Conant Paving, and Section 8/MRVP housing assistance of $978,847.
summary: The meeting covers approval of September payables, payroll, and Section 8/MRVP assistance payments, along with contractor approvals for paving projects and Section 8 reserve transfers. It also includes reports on public housing, rental assistance, and maintenance.
items: Authorize Executive Director to issue payables of $467,249 and payroll of $170,266 for September 2026
Approve and authorize Executive Director to issue Section 8 and MRVP Housing Assistance payments of $978,847 for September 2026
Review of September Financials (if completed by fee accountant)
Approval of Acceptable Low Bid Contractor for the Annual Painting and Related Services Contract
Approval of Certificate of Substantial Completion (CSC) and Certificate of Final Completion (CFC) for the S.I. Services Essex Street Paving Project (030120)
Approval of Change Order #1 for the Roger Conant Paving Project (030128)
Approve policy on paying out employees who manage other Housing Authorities
Approve board resolution authorizing temporary transfer/use of Section 8 Administrative Reserves to cover a housing assistance payment (HAP) shortfall
Received $323k in funding for Foster Youth Vouchers (FYI) and $12k in Admin Fees
